neighbours.label: the word linking a thing to what it is likened to: 'a form of', 'fierce like', French 'aussi X que', 'pareils a'; the other side of the + pole's 'as ... as'
fire: Une main aussi pale que la neige d'hiver.
Un regard aussi froid que l'acier d'une lame.
Workers should treat debt as a form of leverage.
Hiring an apprentice is a form of investment.
Her stare was cold like a winter river.
His laugh rang out sharp like a bell.
Des yeux sombres pareils à ceux des aigles.
Good teaching is a kind of performance.
quiet: Une main posée sur la neige d'hiver.
Un regard vers le bout de la lame.
Workers should pay debt before the due date.
Hiring an apprentice costs more this year.
Her stare followed the winter river north.
His laugh rang out across the bell tower.
Des yeux tournés vers le nid des aigles.
Most teaching takes place in the afternoon.

notes: Card flags the gate-closed regime (78%). Probing was weak and inconsistent: 'aussi blanche que' reached 0.5 but 'aussi belle que' only 0.06. Recorded as a best guess, expected to fail.
